output.name: Missing PLM roles at onboarding (engineer / change coordinator access requests)
output.summary: Users, often new hires, can sign in to PLM but get access denied when opening or creating parts or routing ECOs until a role request is manually approved and granted.

root_cause.text: Likely the PLM account provisioning grants sign-in but not the job-function roles (engineer, change coordinator), so every new hire or team change must file a ticket to get a role granted manually.

quotes.quote: New hire needs the engineer role to create parts.
I can sign in but get access denied when I open parts.

evidence.text: Every ticket shown was resolved the same way, by approving and granting a role, so these are fulfillment requests, not defects.
New hires repeatedly lack the engineer role needed to create parts.

quotes.quote: New hire needs the engineer role to create parts.
New hire needs the engineer role to create parts.

evidence.text: Change coordinator role is requested separately to route ECOs for teams.

quotes.quote: Need change coordinator role to route ECOs for my team.
Need change coordinator role to route ECOs for my team.

evidence.text: Users experience it as an access error rather than knowing to request a role, with titles like access denied or no permission.

output.fix: Automate PLM role provisioning from HR/job-function data (e.g., assign the engineer or change coordinator role when the user's job role is set during onboarding), with a self-service, pre-approved role request for exceptions, so users do not reach PLM without the role they need.
